tools.name: check_package
tools.description: Live check against the npm / PyPI registry and the OSV vulnerability database. Catches hallucinated package names, typosquats, deprecated packages and known vulnerabilities. Price 0.005 USDC per call; first 3 calls per day free.

tools.name: diagnose_devops_error
tools.description: Send an error message from Kubernetes, Helm, Docker, CI/CD, Terraform, Vault, Nginx or Linux. Returns likely cause, fix steps and commands to verify, as JSON. Price 0.02 USDC per call; first 3 calls per day free.

tools.name: check_config_file
tools.description: Finds YAML syntax errors with line numbers plus common deploy-breaking and security mistakes: selector/label mismatch, :latest images, missing resource limits and probes, privileged containers, hard-coded secrets, GitHub Actions security (pwn-request checkouts on pull_request_target, actions not pin

tools.name: scan_dependencies
tools.description: Send package-lock.json, yarn.lock, pnpm-lock.yaml, package.json, requirements.txt, poetry.lock, uv.lock, Pipfile.lock, go.mod, go.sum, Cargo.lock, composer.lock or Gemfile.lock. findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "check_config_file" references sensitive artifacts (secret). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: check_config_file · Private data: check_package, diagnose_devops_error, check_config_file, scan_dependencies · Public sink: diagnose_devops_error, scan_dependencies.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: check_config_file · Private data: check_package, diagnose_devops_error, check_config_file, scan_dependencies · Public sink: diagnose_devops_error, scan_dependencies

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
